text: Dnipro. One last sortie before we head south. More airborne targets than we have faced so far.
He is ready. Though after Lviv, he insists on sniffing every sack of coffee.
As long as he stays awake. Jets pass quickly. Helicopters linger and change altitude. Keep track of both rhythms.
Have you ever flown on someone who picks his own rhythm?
No. That is why I listen to your reports.
Then here is my report: we understand each other. Time to put that to work.
